_note: 學習路徑內容第21批 #2／6：主動被動轉換 active↔passive transform（eng.t_mid.voice.active-passive-transform，會考級／中階）。主動變被動：原受詞變主詞、動詞變 be + 過去分詞、原主詞變 by + 施事者（未知/不重要時常省略）；時態保持不變（現在 is/are + p.p.、過去 was/were + p.p.）。誘答鎖『缺 be 動詞／用進行式取代被動／時態改掉／主詞單複數 be 不一致』等唯一正解；by 片語省略屬正常用法、理由不誇大。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix apt_）。

units.title_zh: 主動與被動的轉換（be + 過去分詞）
units.can_do: 我能把主動句改成被動句：原受詞變主詞、動詞變 be + 過去分詞、原主詞變 by 片語（常省略），並保持時態不變。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In the passive, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject: 'People speak English here.' becomes 'English is spoken here.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動時原受詞變主詞（People speak English → English is spoken）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The passive verb is a form of 'be' + the past participle: 'She made the cake.' becomes 'The cake was made.' The 'be' must agree with the new subject (is/are/was/were).
claims.verification_ref: 被動動詞＝be + 過去分詞；be 與新主詞單複數一致（The cake was made / These houses are built）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The original subject becomes a 'by + agent' phrase, which is often left out when the doer is unknown or unimportant: 'Someone stole my bike.' becomes 'My bike was stolen.'
claims.verification_ref: 原主詞變 by + 施事者，施事者未知/不重要時常省略（My bike was stolen）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The passive keeps the same tense as the active sentence: present 'cleans' to 'is cleaned'; past 'built' to 'was built'.
claims.verification_ref: 被動與主動時態一致（cleans → is cleaned；built → was built）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To make a passive, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and the verb changes to 'be + past participle'. Many people read this book. becomes This book is read by many people. 受詞變主詞，動詞變 be + 過去分詞。
This book is read by many people.　（這本書被很多人閱讀。原受詞 this book 變主詞、動詞變 is read。）
Keep the same tense. If the active verb is past, the passive uses 'was/were + past participle'. They built the bridge in 1990. becomes The bridge was built in 1990. 時態保持不變，過去就用 was/were + 過去分詞。
The bridge was built in 1990.　（這座橋是在 1990 年建造的。主動 built 是過去式，被動也用過去 was built。）

The old subject can become a 'by' phrase, but we often leave it out when the doer is unknown or not important. Somebody cleans this room every day. becomes This room is cleaned every day. 施事者不重要時，by 片語常省略。
This room is cleaned every day.　（這個房間每天被打掃。打掃的人不重要，by 片語省略了。）

practice.stem: 改被動：The chef cooks the meal. → The meal ____ by the chef.（這餐由廚師烹調）

distractor_rationales.cooks: 這是主動的動詞形式，不是被動；被動要 be + 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.is cooking: 這是現在進行式的主動，不是被動；被動要用 is + 過去分詞 cooked。
distractor_rationales.cooked: 缺少 be 動詞；被動要 is cooked（be + 過去分詞）。

practice.feedback: The meal is cooked by the chef：被動＝be + 過去分詞，現在式用 is cooked。

practice.stem: 改被動：Edison invented the light bulb. → The light bulb ____ by Edison.（電燈泡由愛迪生發明）

distractor_rationales.is invented: 原句是過去式（invented），被動也要保持過去式 was invented，不能改成現在式。
distractor_rationales.invented: 缺少 be 動詞；被動要 was invented。
distractor_rationales.was inventing: 這是過去進行式的主動，不是被動；被動要 was + 過去分詞 invented。

practice.feedback: The light bulb was invented by Edison：過去式主動 invented，被動保持過去 was invented。

practice.stem: 改被動：Workers build these houses. → These houses ____ by workers.（這些房子由工人建造）

distractor_rationales.is built: 主詞 these houses 是複數，be 動詞要用 are，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.are building: 這是現在進行式的主動，不是被動；被動要 are + 過去分詞 built。
distractor_rationales.build: 這是主動原形，不是被動；被動要 are built。

practice.feedback: These houses are built by workers：複數主詞配 are，被動用 are + 過去分詞。

practice.stem: 主動句 People speak English in many countries. 的正確被動句是？
practice.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
options: English is spoken in many countries.
English is speak in many countries.
English was spoken in many countries.

be 動詞後要接過去分詞 spoken，不是原形 speak。
這是主動形式且語意不通；被動要 is + 過去分詞 spoken。
原句是現在式（speak），被動要保持現在式 is spoken，用 was 會變成過去式、改了時態。

practice.feedback: English is spoken…：原受詞 English 變主詞、現在式用 is spoken。

practice.stem: My wallet was stolen yesterday. 這句為什麼沒有 by… 片語？
practice.answer: 因為偷的人不知道或不重要，by + 施事者可以省略。
options: 因為偷的人不知道或不重要，by + 施事者可以省略。
因為這句是主動語態，不需要施事者。
因為被動語態規定一定不能有 by 片語。
因為 steal 這個動詞不能有受詞。

distractor_rationales.因為這句是主動語態，不需要施事者。: was stolen 是被動（be + 過去分詞），不是主動。
distractor_rationales.因為被動語態規定一定不能有 by 片語。: 被動句是可以有 by 片語的（My wallet was stolen by a thief.），只是常在施事者不重要時省略。
distractor_rationales.因為 steal 這個動詞不能有受詞。: steal 是及物動詞，可以有受詞（steal my wallet），所以才能變被動。

practice.feedback: 施事者未知或不重要時，by + 施事者常省略，但需要時仍可加上。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The letter was written by my grandmother.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was written（be + 過去分詞）、by my grandmother、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。be 動詞與過去分詞連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: This song is loved by everyone.
lines.intonation: is loved 連讀、句尾 everyone 下收

lines.text: The window was broken last night.
lines.intonation: was broken 連讀、句尾 night 下收
